about: Joanna N is a dedicated personal hairstylist inside The Loft Salon in Downtown Camarillo, specializing in balayages, extensions, long hair, brunettes and Brazilian blowouts, plus custom blonding, coloring, cutting and styling. By appointment only — book on Fresha, or reach her on Instagram @MissJoannaHair.
